AccountOfferCard.description:
A tenant-level offer merged onto the shared, region-cached model card.

Present only when this account has something it can still act on, so its
absence is meaningful: no block means nothing free is waiting.

`status` is `available` or `granted`, and `requires_claim` says which one
matters to the caller: true means send the account owner to `claim_url`
first, false means the video is already theirs and the next matching request
runs at `credits`. Read `requires_claim` before quoting — `credits: "0"` is
what the render costs once the offer is claimed, not a price that already
applies.

TopUpCard.description:
What topping up would cost, present only when the balance cannot start
the cheapest job this card can price.

The options are the catalogue's own list in the catalogue's own order, and
nothing more. No "smallest sufficient" pick, and deliberately no
recommendation flag: endorsing a tier is the same act as ruling one out,
which is what this block exists to stop. The shortfall an agent needs is
already derivable from `balance_credits` and its own estimate; which tier
suits the customer is shown to them on the wallet page, in context.
